_encabezado: AI-assisted (Claude Code) — ROOT, NASA Space Apps 2026
_nota: Assumptions of the data pieces. Each value carries a source and a label; [S] = assumption. The scripts stop if a key is missing. Copy to the working folder (--dir).

ea_gravedad.fuente: No value measured in DR-005 and no source in the repository; sensitivity range proposed by the team

sesgo_eto.fuente: No source in the repository; it tests the hypothesis that POWER-PM overestimates ETo by up to 10 %

presiembra_mm.fuente: Team kit (document 40), A5: pre-planting irrigation of 15–20 cm

plazo_alfalfa_anios.fuente: FIRA AGROCOSTOS 2025: productive life of 3–4 years

plazo_nogal_horizonte.fuente: S9 §5: calculation horizon, not the life of the orchard; the orchard age is not subtracted

umbral_verde_ndvi.fuente: S9 §5; sensitivity 0.35–0.45; to be calibrated with blind labels

umbral_invierno_nogal.fuente: Labeling manual (document 39): dormant pecan 0.10–0.22 in December; margin up to 0.30

viento_alto.fuente: Percentile of ws2m (Feb–Apr 1981–2025) that defines a high-wind day; no published threshold for Delicias

umbral_ruta_ha.fuente: Display value for drawing runoff routes

prof_depresion_ruta_m.fuente: Fill depth above which no route is drawn: above the vertical noise of NASADEM (1–3 m per cell), the elevation model shows a closed depression and does not tell where the water leaves

elevacion_punto_m.fuente: No source in the repository; assumption. The NASADEM median of the area is 1,201 m in Delicias–Saucillo and 1,194 m in Lázaro Cárdenas (nasadem_zona_piloto.tif); with them the psychrometric constant of FAO-56 would change by 0.3 % or less, so the value was not replaced

presiembra_algodon_mm.fuente: No source in the repository; upper end of the range of the team kit

kc_nogal_tabla.fuente: FAO-56, Tabla 12, renglón «Walnut orchard» (Kc ini, mid, end)

cobertura_dosel_nogal.fuente: Effective canopy cover fraction; to be measured with the NDVI of the pecan fields (S8, decision 5). The estimate from NDVI is in nogal_referencia

altura_nogal_m.fuente: Typical height of an adult orchard; it enters FAO-56 Eq. 98

corte_verano_moderado.etiqueta: [P] team kit B3 (skip 2–3 irrigations between July and September); riegos_jul_sep = 6 assumption [S]
corte_verano_moderado.fuente: Team kit (document 40), B3: moderate variant by default

umbral_resiembra_ndvi.fuente: Lowest monthly NDVI of the year below which the field is taken as bare (reseeding or establishment of the alfalfa); in the pilot area, established alfalfa stands have yearly minimums of 0.26 or more and establishment years 0.12–0.24. Sensitivity 0.20–0.30

ea_goteo.fuente: FAO, Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 4, «Irrigation Scheduling» (Brouwer, Prins and Heibloem, 1989), Annex I, Table 8 «Indicative values of the field application efficiency (ea)»: surface irrigation 60 %, sprinkler 75 %, drip 90 %. https://www.fao.org/3/t7202e/t7202e08.htm, read on Nov 14, 2026. General indicative value, not measured in DR-005

ea_superficial_referencia.fuente: FAO, Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 4, «Irrigation Scheduling» (Brouwer, Prins and Heibloem, 1989), Annex I, Table 8 «Indicative values of the field application efficiency (ea)»: surface irrigation 60 %, sprinkler 75 %, drip 90 %. https://www.fao.org/3/t7202e/t7202e08.htm, read on Nov 14, 2026. General indicative value, not measured in DR-005. A reference: the calculation uses the range of ea_gravedad

gedi_piso_instrumento_m.fuente: Own analysis (datos/colab/A11_gedi_parcelas.py, Nov 14, 2026): 10th and 90th percentiles (value = median) of the per-field median rh98 in the 261 fields with 3 or more shots that the rules classify as alfalfa, fallow or winter cereal (no trees). Below that level rh98 reflects the pulse width of the instrument, not plant height

min_disparos.fuente: Minimum valid shots per field to read the height; own criterion

gedi_umbral_dosel_alto_m.fuente: Own criterion (A11, Nov 14, 2026): 90th percentile of the field's rh98 of 5 m or more. With that threshold, 57 of 86 pecan fields with 3 or more shots show tall canopy, against 7 of 95 alfalfa fields and 0 of 11 winter cereal fields

lamina_local_cm._nota: Published irrigation depths for the region, in cm per year or per cycle. They are a REFERENCE to compare with the model depth; the calculation does not use them. 10 cm = 1 thousand m³/ha

recomendada_inifap.fuente: INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3): 170–180 cm per year

aplicada_dr005.fuente: Villalobos-Cano et al. 2024, Sustainability 16(5):1851, DOI 10.3390/su16051851, Tables 2 and 3: DR-005, means for 2009–2016 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3, Oct 29, 2026). The article does not say where the applied water was measured and computes ET with Hargreaves; it serves as a contrast, not as a calibration

et_estimada_dr005.fuente: Villalobos-Cano et al. 2024, Sustainability 16(5):1851, DOI 10.3390/su16051851, Tables 2 and 3: DR-005, means for 2009–2016 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3, Oct 29, 2026). The article does not say where the applied water was measured and computes ET with Hargreaves; it serves as a contrast, not as a calibration

recomendada_inifap.fuente: INIFAP, technology package PT-0003 (2015): 12–14 irrigations and 92 cm by gravity (project dossier, S2 §3)

aplicada_dr005.fuente: Villalobos-Cano et al. 2024, Sustainability 16(5):1851, DOI 10.3390/su16051851, Tables 2 and 3: DR-005, means for 2009–2016 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3, Oct 29, 2026). The article does not say where the applied water was measured and computes ET with Hargreaves; it serves as a contrast, not as a calibration

The article does not say where the applied water was measured and computes ET with Hargreaves; it serves as a contrast, not as a calibration

The article does not say where the applied water was measured and computes ET with Hargreaves; it serves as a contrast, not as a calibration

et_estimada_dr005.fuente: Villalobos-Cano et al. 2024, Sustainability 16(5):1851, DOI 10.3390/su16051851, Tables 2 and 3: DR-005, means for 2009–2016 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3, Oct 29, 2026). recomendada_inifap.fuente: INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017 (verified in the project dossier, S2 §3): ~68 cm (20 cm pre-planting + 48 cm in 4–5 supplementary irrigations)
INIFAP, Folleto Técnico 53 (2014): 5 irrigations of 10–12 cm, including pre-planting (project master document, §5.2)

cobertura_ndvi_relacion.etiqueta: [V] published relation; assumption [S] when applied to adult pecan orchards
cobertura_ndvi_relacion.fuente: Johnson, L.F. and Trout, T.J. (2012), Remote Sensing 4(2):439–455, DOI 10.3390/rs4020439, Eq. 1: Fc = 1.26 × NDVI − 0.18 (r² = 0.96; Landsat NDVI; vegetables, vineyards and young orchards of the San Joaquin Valley; the authors did not verify it in adult orchards). Read on Nov 14, 2026. Used in A12 as a reference; the demand calculation does not use it

nogal_referencia._nota: REFERENCE on the pecan orchards of the pilot areas (A12, Nov 14, 2026). The demand calculation does not use this block: A5 keeps cobertura_dosel_nogal. Details in docs/nogal_cobertura.md

cobertura_estimada_ndvi.fuente: Median and 10th and 90th percentiles of 105 fields classified as pecan in the two areas: maximum NDVI of Jun–Sep 2026 (NASA HLS) converted to cover with cobertura_ndvi_relacion. Consistent with the model's assumption (cobertura_dosel_nogal = 0.7)

kc_mid_estimado.fuente: FAO-56, Eq. 98 with kc_nogal_tabla and altura_nogal_m, applied to the estimated cover of each field (before the climate adjustment). The model uses 1.07

lamina_bruta_millares_ha_p50.fuente: P50 gross irrigation depth of pecan in Delicias–Saucillo (A5) with the cover at the estimated 10th and 90th percentiles (0.57 and 0.83) and with the model's cover (0.7). Range by cover; it does not include the P10–P90 band of climate and efficiency

altura_gedi_p90_m.fuente: Median and 10th and 90th percentiles, among 86 pecan fields with 3 or more GEDI shots, of the 90th percentile of rh98 of each field. The model assumes 10 m (altura_nogal_m); with 7 m the mid-season Kc changes in the second decimal

parcelas_con_patron_huerta_2016_2026.fuente: Of 105 pecan fields, those that show the orchard pattern in all 11 years of the HLS memory (2016–2026): they are at least 11 years old

edad_promedio_huertas_encuesta_anios.fuente: Orona Castillo, I. et al. (2019), «La producción y comercialización de nuez pecanera en México», Revista Mexicana de Ciencias Agrícolas 10(8):1797–1808 (INIFAP journal; https://cienciasagricolas.inifap.gob.mx/index.php/agricolas/article/download/1833/2842/11310), read on Nov 14, 2026: «La edad de los huertos es similar en las tres zonas (27 años en promedio)» (orchard age is similar in the three areas, 27 years on average); surveys of 2014–2015 in the Comarca Lagunera, Jiménez (Chihuahua) and Hermosillo (Sonora). It is not Delicias and it is not the life of the orchard

edad_arboles_unidad_tipica_delicias_anio.fuente: López Díaz, J.C. et al. (2011), «Rentabilidad del nogal pecanero bajo sistemas de producción de mediana tecnología en Delicias, Chihuahua», Revista Mexicana de Agronegocios 29:720–731 (https://ageconsearch.umn.edu/record/114475), read on Nov 14, 2026: typical unit with «árboles con madurez de producción comercial (25 años de edad)» (trees at commercial production maturity, 25 years old). It is not an INIFAP publication and it is not the life of the orchard

vida_huerta_anios.fuente: No INIFAP publication giving the life of the orchard in years was found (search of Nov 14, 2026). No figure is published; what does have a source is the age of orchards in production (see the two previous entries)

suelo_margen_ph.fuente: Own criterion (Nov 14, 2026): a pH difference smaller than this margin between the map and the published limit of a crop is not labeled «outside range» but «near the published limit». It does not come from a pH uncertainty figure: Table 4 of Poggio et al. 2021 (DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021) is an image and could not be read; the text of the article gives model efficiencies (MEC) of 0.31 to 0.74 depending on the property, and ISRIC states that its models explain between 30 % and 70 % of the variation

suelo_coincidencia_textura.fuente: Share of fields where the USDA texture class computed from SoilGrids 2.0 (0–30 cm) equals the OpenLandMap one (0 cm): 584 of 1,238 fields with data in the two pilot areas; in the others they differ by a neighboring class

ecostress_sobrevuelo_seg.fuente: Scenes of the same field less than 5 minutes apart are one overpass and are averaged before the monthly median (in these files, three pairs of scenes 52 s apart: Dec 16, 2025, Feb 26 and Aug 26, 2026); independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md, D5)

ecostress_fraccion_luz.fuente: Passes are used when x, the fraction of the daylight hours elapsed at the pass (0 at sunrise, 1 at sunset), is between these limits. The product turns the instantaneous flux into a daily total with 1.6 · Rn / (π · sin(π · x)) (JPL, github.com/ECOSTRESS-Collection-2/ECOv002-L3T-L4T-JET, ECOv002_L3T_L4T_JET.py, daily_Rn_integration_verma, commit a785b14, read on Nov 15, 2026), so near sunrise or sunset it multiplies a small, noisy flux by more than 2.2 times the noon factor; limits from the independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md, D1)

ecostress_nube_zona_max.fuente: A scene is left out for a pilot area if more than this fraction of the area's points have cloud = 1 in it (May 20 and Jul 2, 2026: 49 % to 99 %; every other scene with data: 4 % or less). The product leaves cloudy pixels empty, so cloud = 0 alone does not remove a pass with half of the area under cloud; independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md, D2)
